name: tia_download_project_texts
description: Export project texts to a new file using explicit cultures; the destination is never overwritten.

project_path.description: Exact full path of a project already open in the connected TIA Portal instance.

destination_file_path.description: Full path for a new export file in an existing directory; an existing file is rejected.

primary_culture.description: Valid .NET culture name used as the primary export language.

reference_culture.description: Valid .NET culture name used as the reference export language.
